llegada.gusano.frase: A wormhole tore me out of my first flight and brought me to a system that isn't mine.

bucle.llegada.frase: I always wake up in front of the Mouth; a crack of light closes behind me.

bucle.orden_camara.frase: The Council ordered a device built to hold the last quarter of an hour.
bucle.orden_camara.rumor: Who is holding this loop up, and why?

bucle.camara.frase: A device, the Chamber, repeats the last fifteen minutes since they left.

bucle.culpa.frase: Whoever built the Chamber carried the guilt of having left it switched on.

deuda.palabra.frase: The plaque at the Mouth speaks of "the count" that "begins today": from the very first day, something was owed.

deuda.relojes_se_separan.frase: The clocks of two worlds drift apart little by little: they have to be compared.

deuda.cancion.frase: A lullaby: "never cross the same Gate twice in the same day."

deuda.puertas_se_buscan.frase: The Gates seek each other: the Mouth answers a distant call.

deuda.es_de_tiempo.frase: The debt is one of time, not of energy: every step drifts the two clocks of a Gate a little further apart.

deuda.uso_diario.frase: They crossed the Gates every day, and each trip added to the debt.

deuda.coste_energia.frase: The Institute believes every passage through a Gate costs energy.

deuda.filtraciones.frase: Micro wormholes "bite" the space around the Gates and leave curved edges.

lectura.horas.frase: I can read how the Absent wrote their hours.

partida.vida_normal.frase: The Absent lived calmly: irrigation shifts, tables set, and the Gates used like someone catching a train.

partida.evacuacion.frase: There was an evacuation notice: forty minutes, Gates 2 to 6.

partida.cascada.frase: The debt spikes soared during the evacuation: fleeing sped up the collapse.
partida.cascada.rumor: What happened to those who crossed the Gates?

silencio.consejo_existe.frase: A Transit Council authorized the use of the Gates.

silencio.investigadora.frase: Someone was waiting for a researcher who never came back.

silencio.version_oficial.frase: The Council declared that the incidents were isolated and posed no risk.

silencio.censura.frase: Three columns of the Index are empty and refer to a "Sealed Room".

silencio.borrado.frase: The researcher's report was filed three times and something was erased each time.

silencio.acta.frase: The Council voted not to report the danger.
silencio.acta.rumor: What did the erased part say?

archivo.entrada.frase: The Archive is entered from below: a shaft at the bottom of the sea, under the third tower.

silencio.economia.frase: The Gates were the economy and the pride of the Absent: nobody wanted to stop them.

silencio.dos_investigadores.frase: The researcher and the skeptic went to the slow place and never wrote again.

silencio.advertencia.frase: The skeptic warned about the Limit and nobody listened.
silencio.advertencia.rumor: Did anyone warn about the danger?

silencio.calma_aparente.frase: From the outside everything looked calm while the collapses had already begun.

silencio.orden.frase: The Council signed the order to stay silent.

silencio.uno_se_quedo.frase: Someone stayed behind in the laboratory.

lab.existe_lugar_lento.frase: There was a secret destination where time barely advanced.
lab.existe_lugar_lento.pista: Whoever shipped cargo, or waited for letters, would have noticed a clock falling behind.

lab.imagen_desplazada.frase: Near the Knot the stars appear where they are not: what you see is not where it seems.
lab.imagen_desplazada.rumor: Where is that place, if what you see is not where it seems?
lab.imagen_desplazada.pista: Someone who watched the sky for a living would have written it down; or a light that only comes in for a while.

lab.correccion.frase: To find the slow place you must correct the displacement of its image.
lab.correccion.rumor: How much must what you see be corrected?
lab.correccion.pista: Someone who worked there left it said, in a voice you must learn to hear; or a console that follows the routes.

nudo.existe.frase: There is a dark, immensely heavy point, the Knot, that bends light.

nudo.origen.frase: The first Gate closed badly: the Knot was born from it.

contrapeso.trasladado.frase: The Counterweight was taken to a final testing site.

contrapeso.reloj.frase: The Counterweight's internal clock matters: it must not be moved without adjusting it.
contrapeso.reloj.pista: Beside where it rested, someone left a warning.

contrapeso.que_es.frase: The Counterweight is a replacement engine that "pays" the debt.
contrapeso.que_es.pista: Where it was made, someone wrote down how it was installed.

contrapeso.sustituye_motor.frase: It is installed in place of the engine of the machine at the Scar.
contrapeso.sustituye_motor.pista: A manual would say; or a factory that still rehearses it on its own.

contrapeso.metodo_sincronia.frase: A travelling clock drifts out of step; the twins' diaries teach how to calculate by how much.
contrapeso.metodo_sincronia.pista: Two people who counted the same days in different places.

contrapeso.medir_desfase.frase: A drift can be measured by comparing calibrated clocks in different places.
contrapeso.medir_desfase.pista: A clock that doesn't keep its place's time can be set by comparing it with another.

contrapeso.cuenta_sincronia.frase: The calculation to correct the Counterweight's clock according to the route it takes.
contrapeso.cuenta_sincronia.rumor: How is the Counterweight's clock corrected?
contrapeso.cuenta_sincronia.pista: The pages missing from the manual must be somewhere.

contrapeso.lugar.frase: The Counterweight is installed in the Engine Room of the Scar.
contrapeso.lugar.pista: Where the machine that opens the Gates stands.

contrapeso.ventana_pulso.frase: The machine's core only opens during the pulse.
contrapeso.ventana_pulso.pista: The machine isn't always open: someone noted when it beats.

contrapeso.terminado.frase: The Counterweight is finished, but untested.

bocas.relojes_distintos.frase: Each mouth of a Gate carries its own time; that is why things arrive from different eras.
bocas.relojes_distintos.pista: Letters that answer too early, or a list of worlds with their hours.

casa.prueba_llama.frase: A new mouth is calling from a young system.
casa.prueba_llama.pista: The machine keeps count of who calls the network.

casa.prueba_plazo.frase: The Institute's great test is in a few days.
casa.prueba_plazo.pista: At home they said it out loud, and it was on a blackboard.

casa.pruebas_menores.frase: At home they are building a small Gate and running "minor tests".

casa.fragmento_isla.frase: On the island of the first Albatross I found a small piece with a smooth, curved edge.

casa.mision_luna.frase: The Director sends me to the Moon to study the largest fragment.

casa.directora_dirige.frase: The Director leads the Institute's great test.

casa.fragmentos_curvos.frase: The fragments at home have smooth, curved edges.

casa.bordes_son_mordidas.frase: Those curved edges are bites from micro wormholes.

casa.simbolo_partido.frase: A fragment at home carries half a symbol of unknown meaning.

casa.fragmentos_de_aqui.frase: The fragments at home came from the "bites" at the Scar.

casa.simbolo_encaja.frase: The other half of the symbol is still on a wall at the Scar: that fragment came from there.

casa.fragmento_antiguo.frase: The Moon's fragment is older than the earlier ones, but it arrived later.

casa.en_la_red.frase: The home system already appears in the network of the Gates.

puertas.otros_viajeros.frase: Others arrived here before me, through mouths from different eras. The last row of the wall is blank.

silencio.no_cruzaron.frase: The names of the three from the Laboratory are not on the wall: they never crossed.

bocas.vuelta_antes.frase: Counting the drift, only one of the mouths at home puts me back before the great test.

contrapeso.planos.frase: The Counterweight's plans remain in the Archive's Bank: with them another could be built.

nudo.sellado.frase: The first throat could not be closed: they sealed it, folded it and sent it far from Scar.

deuda.mundo_vaciado.frase: They hollowed Scar out from within to forge the rings of the Gates.

deuda.garganta_maquina.frase: A tiny throat sleeps at the centre of Scar; the machine surrounds it so it will not grow.

partida.ultimas_salidas.frase: In the Departures Hall they crossed out the departures one by one; the last one has no destination.

deuda.anillo_de_mordidas.frase: Scar's ring is the rock the bites tore off and did not take.

umbral.hogar_ausentes.frase: Umbral was the home of the Absent: the first Gate was opened from here.

partida.precipitada.frase: They left recently and in a hurry: devices on standby, tools on the table, work half done.

archivo.hora_ranura.frase: At four o'clock, the Ember's light comes in through the Archive's slot.

casa.planos_completan.frase: These plans are exactly what the Institute's Gate is missing: with them, its test would work.

mundos.cuenta.frase: In the Classroom they count a rhyme about a rolling ball: one, four, nine… farther each time.
mundos.cuenta.rumor: What does the rhyme of the ball in the Classroom count?

mundos.compas.frase: The bells ring in time at marks 1, 4, 9 and 16: the ball speeds up, so each bell must sit farther down.
mundos.compas.rumor: Where must the bells go to ring in time?

mundos.cancion.frase: A song names the worlds from the Ember: Workshop runs, Scar burns, Archive weighs, Threshold waits… Observatory watches.
mundos.cancion.rumor: What does the lectern of the bells sing?

observatorio.alineacion.frase: At 6:30 the Observatory, the Ember and the world-less rail fall in line.
observatorio.alineacion.rumor: When do the worlds of the Orrery line up?

lab.riel_vacio.frase: In the Orrery there is a rail with no world, between Threshold and the Observatory.
lab.riel_vacio.rumor: Why is there a spare rail in the Orrery?
